changes: Threaded metadataRoot through review-run snapshot and reviewer evidence freshness so wrapper-root custom storyDir metadata-only commits no longer false-stale reviewer runs. Added smoke coverage for capture, assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence, validateEvidenceRunBinding via collectReviewerEvidenceState, legacy fallback, and default projectRoot identity.
usage: Use the existing review_run_start, review_pass_set, reviewer evidence checks, and review escalation gates normally. In wrapper-root or custom storyDir setups, review-run freshness now evaluates material/story files against the signed workspaceBinding metadataRoot instead of accidentally treating metadata-only storyDir churn as production material drift.
expectedOutcome: Reviewer runs and passes should remain fresh after metadata-only commits in a wrapper-root custom storyDir setup, while real material drift still invalidates stale evidence. Existing plain-repo and legacy no-workspaceBinding cases should behave exactly as before.
actualTranscript: Final verification passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-run-metadataroot-wrapper-root; lattice validate --story=B-9dcb --json with 31 configured commands; lattice done_required_validate with packages/main build and root npm test. Review lanes concept, quality, and test-coverage all passed after F-003; 3 rounds x 2 hosts were submitted with claude-cli and codex-cli only.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The test-coverage reviewer found F-003 before DONE because validateEvidenceRunBinding was not covered; the fix added the collector-path smoke coverage and reviewers confirmed it.
limitations: Scope warnings remain advisory for ProofStory metadata artifacts generated by the lifecycle. No Authority Server production claim is made. agy-cli was not used for the final 3x2 because codex-cli and claude-cli were available.
pitfalls: Do not reuse stale reviewer passes after storyFilesHash changes. If review evidence goes stale, return to REVIEW and regenerate explicit reviewer-lane passes before quorum_submit. Keep agy-cli as fallback only, not a primary quorum host.
